thesis: Hymn to Tourach compresses two random cards of disruption into two mana, making every early cast capable of destroying either a plan or the mana needed to execute it.

competitiveTimeline.significance: Hymn defined black disruption in Fallen Empires, The Rack strategies, and Legacy midrange, remaining one of the most feared examples of efficient random discard.

playbook.role: Cast Hymn while the opponent’s hand is still dense with important resources, especially before they can deploy redundant cards. Build the mana base to produce double black without sacrificing tempo.

counterplay.directAnswers: Empty key cards quickly, use graveyard value, draw engines, or redundant threats, and avoid mulligans that leave a fragile low-card hand. There is no sequencing that fully controls the random discard.
